"""M↔P integration: archive acquisition stays outside pure measurement functions.

No measurements on display stacks. Results retain native frames, scales and reasons
for every failed fit. Release flags remain off until the corresponding gates pass.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

import numpy as np
from astropy.coordinates import SkyCoord
from astropy.io import fits
from astropy.time import Time
from fastapi import HTTPException

from spherex.astrometry import isolated, motion_fit, parallax_factors, registration
from spherex.epsf import EPSF, fit_blend, fit_native
from spherex.external.gaia import GaiaClient
from spherex.external.horizons import CENTER, positions
from spherex.photometry import spectrum_point
from spherex.preprocess import calibrate
from spherex.targets import Target

from . import calibration
from .pipeline import plan_view
from .science import _raws


def validity(svc: Any, flag: str) -> str:
    return "accepted" if svc.features().get(flag) == "on" else "unvalidated"


async def inputs(
    svc: Any,
    ra: float,
    dec: float,
    key: str | None = None,
    name: str = "",
    release: str = "",
    min_fov: float = 0,
    detectors: tuple[int, ...] | None = None,
) -> tuple[Any, Any, Any]:
    if svc.calib_spec[0] != "locked":
        raise HTTPException(
            409, "Measurement requires locked CWAVE, CBAND, ePSF and solid-angle maps; fixture slices are insufficient"
        )
    m = svc.store.manifest(key) if key else None
    if key and m is None:
        raise HTTPException(404, "unknown pinned view")
    if m is None:
        plan = await plan_view(svc, dict(q=name) if name else dict(ra=str(ra), dec=str(dec), fov="12", px="6.15"))
        from .pipeline import skeleton

        m = skeleton(svc, plan)
        m["_refs"] = [dict(f.__dict__) for f in plan.refs]
        m["_plan"] = dict(grid_args=plan.grid_args, preset=plan.preset)
    if min_fov and float(m["_plan"]["grid_args"][2]) < min_fov:
        import copy

        m = copy.deepcopy(m)
        grid_args = list(m["_plan"]["grid_args"])
        grid_args[2] = min_fov
        m["_plan"]["grid_args"] = grid_args
    m.setdefault("_measurement_fetch_skipped", []).extend(
        [[f["id"], f["skipped"]] for f in m.get("frames", []) if f.get("skipped") is not None]
    )
    from spherex.types import FrameRef

    usable = {f["id"] for f in m.get("frames", []) if f.get("skipped") is None}
    refs = [FrameRef(**r) for r in m.get("_refs", [])]
    raws = await _raws(
        svc,
        m,
        [
            r
            for r in refs
            if r.id in usable
            and (not release or release in r.collection)
            and (detectors is None or r.detector in detectors)
        ],
    )
    if not raws:
        raise HTTPException(409, "No native frames available for this measurement")
    planned_target = m.get("_plan", {}).get("target") or {}
    if planned_target.get("kind") == "sso":
        if svc.client is None:
            raise HTTPException(409, "Tracked SSO measurement requires exact midpoint Horizons positions")
        times = sorted({float(r.hdus["IMAGE"][0]["MJD-AVG"]) for r in raws})
        extra = planned_target.setdefault("extra", {})
        xy = await positions(svc.client, extra.get("command", planned_target["name"]), times)
        extra.setdefault("ephemeris", {}).update({str(t): p for t, p in zip(times, xy, strict=True)})
    cal = calibration.load(svc.calib_spec)
    return m, raws, cal


def epsfs(cal: Any, detectors: Any) -> dict[int, EPSF]:
    return {d: EPSF(fits.getdata(cal.path("epsf", d), extname="EPSF")) for d in set(detectors)}


def target_from_manifest(m: Any, ra: float, dec: float, track: bool) -> Target:
    t = m.get("target") or {}
    if track and t.get("kind") == "sso":
        planned = m.get("_plan", {}).get("target")
        if planned is None:
            raise HTTPException(409, "Tracked SSO measurement is missing its ephemeris provenance")
        return Target(**planned)
    pm = t.get("pm") or [None, None]
    if track and t.get("kind") == "star":
        from spherex.targets import sep_arcsec

        if (
            sep_arcsec(
                ra,
                dec,
                t.get("propagated_now", {}).get("ra", t["ra"]),
                t.get("propagated_now", {}).get("dec", t["dec"]),
            )
            < 30
        ):
            return Target(
                "",
                "star",
                t["name"],
                t["ra"],
                t["dec"],
                t["epoch"],
                pm[0],
                pm[1],
                t.get("plx"),
                t.get("rv"),
                astrometry_source=t.get("astrometry_source"),
            )
    return Target("", "coords", "selected sky", ra, dec)


async def spectrum_api(
    svc: Any, ra: float, dec: float, track: bool = True, visits: str = "all", key: str | None = None
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    m, raws, cal = await inputs(svc, ra, dec, key)
    target = target_from_manifest(m, ra, dec, track)
    psfs = epsfs(cal, [int(r.hdus["IMAGE"][0]["DETECTOR"]) for r in raws])
    fid_to_bin = {f["id"]: f["bin"] for f in m["frames"]}
    rows = []
    skipped = list(m.get("_measurement_fetch_skipped", []))
    scales = set()
    # Known crossing star from understanding.md §8.4; use its recorded Gaia astrometry.
    neighbours = []
    if "0855" in target.name:
        if svc.client is None:
            raise HTTPException(
                409, "WISE 0855 needs Gaia DR3 5756956644387831296 for simultaneous two-source photometry"
            )
        neighbours = await GaiaClient(svc.client).by_id([5756956644387831296])
        if not neighbours:
            raise HTTPException(409, "WISE 0855 contaminant astrometry unavailable")
    field = []
    if svc.client is not None:
        from astropy import units as u

        candidates = await GaiaClient(svc.client).cone(ra, dec, 0.1, g_max=17.0)
        for g in candidates:
            c = SkyCoord(g.ra * u.deg, g.dec * u.deg)
            if g.ruwe is None or g.ruwe > 1.5 or c.separation(SkyCoord(ra * u.deg, dec * u.deg)).arcsec < 20:
                continue
            if any(
                c.separation(SkyCoord(o.ra * u.deg, o.dec * u.deg)).arcsec < 18
                for o in candidates
                if o.source_id != g.source_id
            ):
                continue
            field.append(g)
            if len(field) >= 8:
                break
    field_points: dict[Any, list[Any]] = {}
    index_points: dict[Any, list[Any]] = {}
    for raw in raws:
        fid = raw.ref.id if raw.ref else "?"
        visit = fid_to_bin.get(fid, "?")
        if visits != "all" and visit not in visits.split(","):
            continue
        cf = calibrate(raw, cal, preset="photometry")
        a, d = target.pos([cf.mjd])
        x, y = map(float, cf.wcs.world_to_pixel_values(a[0], d[0]))
        xp, yp = int(round(x + cf.origin[0])), int(round(y + cf.origin[1]))
        if not (0 <= xp < 2040 and 0 <= yp < 2040):
            skipped.append([fid, "target outside parent detector"])
            continue
        neigh = []
        for g in neighbours:
            t = Target(
                "", "star", str(g.source_id), g.ra, g.dec, 2016.0, g.pmra, g.pmdec, g.parallax, g.radial_velocity
            )
            na, nd = t.pos([cf.mjd])
            neigh.append((na[0], nd[0]))
        point = spectrum_point(cf, psfs[cf.detector], a[0], d[0], float(cal.solid_angle[cf.detector][yp, xp]), neigh)
        if point is None:
            skipped.append([fid, "QA, off-edge, missing calibration or degenerate native ePSF fit"])
            continue
        scales.add(point["photometric_scale"])
        index_points.setdefault((visit, point["photometric_scale"]), []).append(point)
        if cf.detector in (4, 5):
            for g in field:
                ft = Target(
                    "", "star", str(g.source_id), g.ra, g.dec, 2016.0, g.pmra, g.pmdec, g.parallax, g.radial_velocity
                )
                fa, fd = ft.pos([cf.mjd])
                fx, fy = map(float, cf.wcs.world_to_pixel_values(fa[0], fd[0]))
                fpx, fpy = int(round(fx + cf.origin[0])), int(round(fy + cf.origin[1]))
                if not (0 <= fpx < 2040 and 0 <= fpy < 2040):
                    continue
                fp = spectrum_point(cf, psfs[cf.detector], fa[0], fd[0], float(cal.solid_angle[cf.detector][fpy, fpx]))
                if fp is not None and not fp["contaminated"]:
                    field_points.setdefault((visit, point["photometric_scale"], g.source_id), []).append(fp)
        rows.append(
            dict(
                lam=point["lam"],
                dlam=point["dlam"],
                flux=point["flux_uJy"],
                err=point["err_uJy"],
                mjd=cf.mjd,
                visit=visit,
                detector=cf.detector,
                flags=point["flags_near"],
                rchi2=point["rchi2"],
                contaminated=point["contaminated"],
                release=raw.release,
                quality=point,
                frame_id=fid,
            )
        )
    from spherex.photometry import methane_index, wise_colour

    by_visit = {}
    for (visit, scale), points in index_points.items():
        ratios = []
        for (v, s, _gid), field_spectrum in field_points.items():
            if v != visit or s != scale:
                continue
            try:
                ratios.append(methane_index(field_spectrum, [1.0])["methane_rel"])
            except ValueError:
                continue
        if len(ratios) >= 3:
            try:
                by_visit[f"{visit}:{scale}"] = methane_index(points, ratios)
            except ValueError:
                pass
        try:
            colour = wise_colour(points)
            by_visit.setdefault(f"{visit}:{scale}", {})["w1w2_syn"] = colour
        except (ValueError, FileNotFoundError):
            pass
    latest = next(reversed(by_visit.values()), None) if by_visit else None
    from spherex.templates import template_overlays

    return dict(
        ra=ra,
        dec=dec,
        rows=rows,
        indices=dict(methane_rel=latest.get("methane_rel"), w1w2_syn=latest.get("w1w2_syn")) if latest else None,
        indices_by_visit=by_visit,
        templates=template_overlays(rows),
        validity=validity(svc, "spectrum"),
        notes=[
            "Signed native-frame flux; 3% calibration floor retained separately. Methane indices require at least three field-star spectra in the same visit and release scale.",
            "QR2 and QR3 rows are separate scales; cross-release indices and light curves prohibited until F4.",
            "Synthetic W1-W2 uses official WISE responses and Vega offsets; W2 is approximate because SPHEREx ends at 5 microns.",
        ],
        skipped=skipped,
        photometric_scales=sorted(scales),
        pin=m.get("pin"),
        native_frames=[r.ref.id for r in raws if r.ref is not None],
    )


async def astrometry_api(svc: Any, ra: float, dec: float, name: str = "", key: str | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    planned = svc.store.manifest(key) if key else None
    wise = "0855" in name or "0855" in str((planned or {}).get("target", {}).get("name", ""))
    m, raws, cal = await inputs(
        svc, ra, dec, key=key, name=name, min_fov=30 if wise else 12, detectors=(6,) if wise else None
    )
    target = target_from_manifest(m, ra, dec, True)
    if svc.client is None:
        raise HTTPException(409, "Differential astrometry needs Gaia stars in a >=12 arcmin registration region")
    stars = await GaiaClient(svc.client).cone(ra, dec, 0.25 if wise else 0.1, g_max=18.0)
    keep = isolated([s.ra for s in stars], [s.dec for s in stars])
    stars = [s for s, k in zip(stars, keep, strict=True) if k]
    psfs = epsfs(cal, [int(r.hdus["IMAGE"][0]["DETECTOR"]) for r in raws])
    points = []
    skipped = list(m.get("_measurement_fetch_skipped", []))
    reg = []
    from astropy import units as u

    ref = SkyCoord(ra * u.deg, dec * u.deg)
    fbin = {f["id"]: f["bin"] for f in m["frames"]}
    full_bins = {(int(band), b["id"]) for band, bs in m["bins"].items() for b in bs if b["status"] == "full"}
    times = [float(r.hdus["IMAGE"][0]["MJD-AVG"]) for r in raws]
    predictions = {}
    for s in stars:
        if s.ruwe is None or s.ruwe > 1.5 or s.pmra is None:
            continue
        if SkyCoord(s.ra * u.deg, s.dec * u.deg).separation(ref).arcsec < 15:
            continue
        t = Target("", "star", str(s.source_id), s.ra, s.dec, 2016.0, s.pmra, s.pmdec, s.parallax, s.radial_velocity)
        predictions[s.source_id] = t.pos(times)
    target_ra, target_dec = target.pos(times)
    neighbours = await GaiaClient(svc.client).by_id([5756956644387831296]) if "0855" in target.name else []
    neighbour_pos = None
    if neighbours:
        g = neighbours[0]
        neighbour_pos = Target(
            "", "star", str(g.source_id), g.ra, g.dec, 2016.0, g.pmra, g.pmdec, g.parallax, g.radial_velocity
        ).pos(times)
    for frame_index, raw in enumerate(raws):
        cf = calibrate(raw, cal, preset="photometry")
        fid = raw.ref.id if raw.ref else "?"
        if not cf.qa["ok"]:
            skipped.append([fid, "frame QA"])
            continue
        residuals = []
        errors = []
        for s in stars:
            if s.source_id not in predictions:
                continue
            a, d = (p[frame_index] for p in predictions[s.source_id])
            x, y = map(float, cf.wcs.world_to_pixel_values(a, d))
            # OVERFLOW retained for photometry, excluded for astrometric reference stars.
            bad = cf.bad_phot | ((cf.flags & cf.bits.get("OVERFLOW", 0)) != 0)
            try:
                fit = fit_native(
                    cf.sci,
                    cf.var,
                    bad,
                    psfs[cf.detector],
                    psfs[cf.detector].zone(x + cf.origin[0], y + cf.origin[1]),
                    x,
                    y,
                )
            except ValueError:
                continue
            if fit is None or fit.params[2] < 10 * fit.errors[2] or fit.wing_fit:
                continue
            a1, d1 = cf.wcs.pixel_to_world_values(*fit.params[:2])
            dx, dy = SkyCoord(a * u.deg, d * u.deg).spherical_offsets_to(SkyCoord(a1 * u.deg, d1 * u.deg))
            residuals.append([dx.arcsec, dy.arcsec])
            from spherex.astrometry import sky_covariance

            errors.append(
                np.sqrt(
                    np.diag(sky_covariance(cf.wcs, float(fit.params[0]), float(fit.params[1]), fit.covariance[:2, :2]))
                )
            )
        try:
            rr = registration(residuals, errors)
        except (ValueError, IndexError):
            skipped.append([fid, "fewer than five isolated unsaturated registration stars"])
            continue
        x, y = map(float, cf.wcs.world_to_pixel_values(target_ra[frame_index], target_dec[frame_index]))
        try:
            iz = psfs[cf.detector].zone(x + cf.origin[0], y + cf.origin[1])
            fit = (
                None
                if "0855" in target.name
                else fit_native(
                    cf.sci,
                    cf.var,
                    cf.bad_phot | ((cf.flags & cf.bits.get("OVERFLOW", 0)) != 0),
                    psfs[cf.detector],
                    iz,
                    x,
                    y,
                )
            )
        except ValueError:
            fit = None
        if fit is None and "0855" not in target.name:
            skipped.append([fid, "target native centroid unconstrained"])
            continue
        if "0855" in target.name:
            if neighbour_pos is None:
                skipped.append([fid, "WISE contaminant astrometry unavailable"])
                continue
            nx, ny = map(
                float, cf.wcs.world_to_pixel_values(neighbour_pos[0][frame_index], neighbour_pos[1][frame_index])
            )
            # The fixed contaminant must live in the measured local WCS frame.
            # Otherwise its catalogue/WCS residual is absorbed by the faint
            # target's centroid and flux. Both seeds receive the same sky offset.
            shifted_target = SkyCoord(
                target_ra[frame_index] * u.deg, target_dec[frame_index] * u.deg
            ).spherical_offsets_by(rr["offset"][0] * u.arcsec, rr["offset"][1] * u.arcsec)
            shifted_neighbour = SkyCoord(
                neighbour_pos[0][frame_index] * u.deg, neighbour_pos[1][frame_index] * u.deg
            ).spherical_offsets_by(rr["offset"][0] * u.arcsec, rr["offset"][1] * u.arcsec)
            x, y = map(float, cf.wcs.world_to_pixel(shifted_target))
            nx, ny = map(float, cf.wcs.world_to_pixel(shifted_neighbour))
            nz = psfs[cf.detector].zone(nx + cf.origin[0], ny + cf.origin[1])
            fit = fit_blend(cf.sci, cf.var, cf.bad_phot, psfs[cf.detector], [(x, y), (nx, ny)], [iz, nz])
            if fit is None:
                skipped.append([fid, "unconstrained free-position blend fit"])
                continue
        if fit is None:
            skipped.append([fid, "native centroid unavailable"])
            continue
        a1, d1 = cf.wcs.pixel_to_world_values(*fit.params[:2])
        xi, eta = ref.spherical_offsets_to(SkyCoord(a1 * u.deg, d1 * u.deg))
        from spherex.astrometry import sky_covariance

        centroid_cov = sky_covariance(cf.wcs, float(fit.params[0]), float(fit.params[1]), fit.covariance[:2, :2])
        err = np.sqrt(np.diag(centroid_cov) + rr["error"] ** 2)
        points.append(
            dict(
                visit=fbin.get(fid, "?"),
                mjd=cf.mjd,
                xi=float(xi.arcsec - rr["offset"][0]),
                eta=float(eta.arcsec - rr["offset"][1]),
                s_xi=float(err[0]),
                s_eta=float(err[1]),
                band=cf.detector,
                frame_id=fid,
                cov_xi_eta=float(centroid_cov[0, 1]),
                fit_included=(cf.detector, fbin.get(fid, "?")) in full_bins
                and ("0855" not in target.name or cf.detector == 6),
            )
        )
        reg.append(dict(frame=fid, before=rr["before_rms"].tolist(), after=rr["after_rms"].tolist()))
    fitout = None
    fit_points = [p for p in points if p["fit_included"]]
    if len(fit_points) > 2:
        ts = Time([p["mjd"] for p in fit_points], format="mjd").jyear
        pa, pd = parallax_factors([p["mjd"] for p in fit_points], ra, dec)
        try:
            r = motion_fit(
                ts,
                [p["xi"] for p in fit_points],
                [p["eta"] for p in fit_points],
                [p["s_xi"] for p in fit_points],
                [p["s_eta"] for p in fit_points],
                pa,
                pd,
                float(np.mean(ts)),
                (target.plx or 0) / 1000.0,
                xy_covariance=[p["cov_xi_eta"] for p in fit_points],
            )
            mu = r["params"][2:4]
            cov = r["covariance"][2:4, 2:4]
            amp = float(np.linalg.norm(mu))
            fitout = dict(
                pmra=mu[0],
                pmdec=mu[1],
                e_pmra=r["errors"][2],
                e_pmdec=r["errors"][3],
                mu=amp,
                e_mu=float(np.sqrt(mu @ cov @ mu) / amp) if amp else float(np.sqrt(np.trace(cov))),
                pa_deg=float(np.degrees(np.arctan2(mu[0], mu[1])) % 360),
                plx_fixed=None if r["plx_fixed"] is None else r["plx_fixed"] * 1000.0,
                chi2=r["chi2"],
                dof=r["dof"],
                delta_chi2=r["delta_chi2"],
            )
        except (ValueError, np.linalg.LinAlgError) as e:
            skipped.append(["motion-fit", str(e)])
    catalogue = None
    if target.pmra is not None and target.pmdec is not None:
        catalogue = dict(
            source=target.astrometry_source or "manifest catalogue",
            pmra=target.pmra / 1000.0,
            pmdec=target.pmdec / 1000.0,
            mu=float(np.hypot(target.pmra, target.pmdec) / 1000.0),
            pa_deg=float(np.degrees(np.arctan2(target.pmra, target.pmdec)) % 360),
        )
    return dict(
        name=target.name,
        points=points,
        fit=fitout,
        catalogue=catalogue,
        validity=validity(svc, "astrometry"),
        skipped=skipped,
        registration=reg,
        tangent_origin=[ra, dec],
        pin=m.get("pin"),
        native_frames=[r.ref.id for r in raws if r.ref is not None],
    )


async def sso_api(svc: Any, name: str, mjd: list[float]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if svc.client is None:
        raise HTTPException(409, "Horizons client unavailable offline")
    try:
        rows = await positions(svc.client, name, mjd)
    except ValueError as e:
        raise HTTPException(422, str(e)) from e
    return dict(
        name=name, observer=CENTER, points=[dict(mjd=t, ra=a, dec=d) for t, (a, d) in zip(mjd, rows, strict=True)]
    )


async def lightcurve_api(
    svc: Any,
    ra: float,
    dec: float,
    bin: str = "14d",
    bands: str = "",
    method: str = "psf",
    release: str = "",
    key: str | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    from spherex.lightcurve import annulus_measure, correlated_periodogram, normalized_curve

    if method not in ("psf", "annulus"):
        raise HTTPException(400, "method must be psf or annulus")
    try:
        width = float(bin.removesuffix("d"))
    except ValueError:
        raise HTTPException(400, "bin must be a number of days, e.g. 14d") from None
    if not np.isfinite(width) or width <= 0:
        raise HTTPException(400, "bin width must be finite and positive")
    if release not in ("", "qr2", "qr3"):
        raise HTTPException(400, "release must be qr2 or qr3")
    m, raws, cal = await inputs(svc, ra, dec, key=key, release=release)
    target = target_from_manifest(m, ra, dec, True)
    psfs = epsfs(cal, [int(r.hdus["IMAGE"][0]["DETECTOR"]) for r in raws]) if method == "psf" else {}
    data = []
    skipped = list(m.get("_measurement_fetch_skipped", []))
    for raw in raws:
        cf = calibrate(raw, cal, preset="photometry")
        if bands and str(cf.detector) not in bands.split(","):
            continue
        a, d = target.pos([cf.mjd])
        x, y = map(float, cf.wcs.world_to_pixel_values(a[0], d[0]))
        xp, yp = int(round(x + cf.origin[0])), int(round(y + cf.origin[1]))
        try:
            if not cf.qa["ok"] or not (0 <= xp < 2040 and 0 <= yp < 2040):
                raise ValueError("QA or outside detector")
            if method == "annulus":
                f, e = annulus_measure(cf.sci, cf.var, cf.bad_phot, x, y)
            else:
                p = spectrum_point(cf, psfs[cf.detector], a[0], d[0], float(cal.solid_angle[cf.detector][yp, xp]))
                if p is None or p["contaminated"]:
                    raise ValueError("invalid or contaminated ePSF fit")
                # A shared multiplicative calibration cancels in F/Sref;
                # do not count that common floor as independent sample noise.
                f, e = p["flux_uJy"], p["stat_err_uJy"]
            data.append(
                dict(
                    detector=cf.detector,
                    channel=int(cal.channel[yp, xp]),
                    region=(xp // 100, yp // 100),
                    mjd=cf.mjd,
                    flux=f,
                    err=e,
                    scale=cf.photometric_scale,
                )
            )
        except (ValueError, IndexError) as ex:
            skipped.append([cf.obsid, str(ex)])
    try:
        normalized = normalized_curve(data, width, method)
        curves = normalized["bands"]
    except ValueError as ex:
        raise HTTPException(409, str(ex)) from ex
    # Six detector measurements in one time bin are one epoch, not six bins.
    grouped: dict[str, list[Any]] = {}
    for band, values in curves.items():
        for point in values:
            if point["err"] > 0:
                grouped.setdefault(point["bin"], []).append(dict(point, detector=band))
    allpoints: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    merge = np.zeros((len(grouped), len(normalized["covariance_order"])))
    for binid, points in grouped.items():
        weight = np.array([1 / p["err"] ** 2 for p in points])
        for p, w in zip(points, weight / weight.sum(), strict=True):
            merge[len(allpoints), normalized["covariance_order"].index([p["detector"], binid])] = w
        allpoints.append(
            dict(
                mjd=float(weight @ np.array([p["mjd"] for p in points]) / weight.sum()),
                rel=float(weight @ np.array([p["rel"] for p in points]) / weight.sum()),
                err=float(1 / np.sqrt(weight.sum())),
                bin=binid,
            )
        )
    pg = None
    if allpoints:
        try:
            pg = correlated_periodogram(
                [p["mjd"] for p in allpoints],
                [p["rel"] for p in allpoints],
                merge @ np.asarray(normalized["covariance"]) @ merge.T,
            )
        except ValueError:
            pass
    return dict(
        bands=curves,
        covariance=normalized["covariance"],
        covariance_order=normalized["covariance_order"],
        reference_spectrum=normalized["reference"],
        uncertainty=normalized.get("uncertainty", "No usable repeated channels")
        + " Periodogram uses propagated covariance; simulated FAP is conditional on that estimated Gaussian noise model, not PSF or temporal-template systematics.",
        periodogram=pg,
        method=method,
        label="relative, qualitative" if method == "annulus" else "relative, spectrally normalized",
        validity=validity(svc, "lightcurve"),
        photometric_scales=sorted({r["scale"] for r in data}),
        pin=m.get("pin"),
        native_frames=[r.ref.id for r in raws if r.ref is not None],
        skipped=skipped,
    )


async def movers_api(svc: Any, key: str, mode: str = "stellar") -> dict[str, Any]:
    from spherex.linking import link_detections, score_chain

    # Detection products are persisted with native-frame vetting by the mover job.
    m = svc.store.manifest(key)
    if m is None:
        raise HTTPException(404, "unknown view")
    detections = m.get("_native_detections")
    if detections is None:
        detections = await native_detections(svc, m)
    if mode == "planetx":
        if not m.get("axis", "").startswith("bin:1d") or float(m["params"]["fov"]) < 30:
            raise HTTPException(409, "Planet X linking requires per-day bins and FOV >=30 arcmin")
        from spherex.epochs import cluster_visits
        from spherex.planetx import infer_distance, link_orphans

        rows = [d for epoch in detections for d in epoch]
        from spherex.linking import vet_detection

        rows = [d for d in rows if not d.get("known") and not vet_detection(d, 3.0)]
        if not rows:
            return dict(key=key, candidates=[], validity=validity(svc, "planetx"))
        labels = cluster_visits(np.array([d["mjd"] for d in rows]))
        for row, label in zip(rows, labels, strict=True):
            row["day"] = int(row["mjd"])
            row["visit"] = f"V{label}"
        out = []
        for i, planet_chain in enumerate(link_orphans(rows, *m["grid"]["crval"])):
            data = planet_chain["chain"]
            try:
                r = infer_distance(
                    [p["mjd"] for p in data],
                    [p["xi"] for p in data],
                    [p["eta"] for p in data],
                    [max(p["s_xi"], p["s_eta"]) for p in data],
                    *m["grid"]["crval"],
                )
            except (ValueError, np.linalg.LinAlgError):
                continue
            out.append(
                dict(
                    id=f"planetx-{i}",
                    ra=data[0]["ra"],
                    dec=data[0]["dec"],
                    visits=sorted({p["visit"] for p in data}),
                    distance_au=r["distance_au"],
                    distance_error_au=r["error_au"],
                    why=[
                        planet_chain["label"],
                        f"grid hypothesis {planet_chain['distance_grid_au']} AU; bounded orbital nuisance",
                    ],
                    score=None,
                    known=None,
                    pm_arcsec_yr=None,
                    pa_deg=None,
                )
            )
        return dict(key=key, candidates=out, validity=validity(svc, "planetx"))
    out = []
    skipped = []
    for chain in link_detections(detections):
        if len(chain) < 3:
            continue
        try:
            result = score_chain(chain, chain[0].get("catalogue_parallax"), max_rchi2=3.0)
        except (ValueError, np.linalg.LinAlgError) as ex:
            skipped.append([str(chain[0]["id"]), str(ex)])
            continue
        if result["candidate"]:
            out.append(
                dict(
                    id=str(chain[0]["id"]),
                    ra=chain[0]["ra"],
                    dec=chain[0]["dec"],
                    pm_arcsec_yr=result["mu"],
                    pa_deg=result["pa_deg"],
                    visits=[d["visit"] for d in chain],
                    known=result["known"],
                    score=result["score"],
                )
            )
    return dict(key=key, candidates=out, validity=validity(svc, "movers"), skipped=skipped)


async def native_detections(svc: Any, m: dict[str, Any]) -> list[list[dict[str, Any]]]:
    """I detection → M native fits, labels and artifact vetting. Never centroid a display image."""
    from astropy import units as u

    from spherex.grid import frame_to_grid, make_grid, significance
    from spherex.movers import detect, red_sum
    from spherex.stack import build_stack, sky_pixels

    from .science import _refs, _tbin

    cal = calibration.load(svc.calib_spec)
    if svc.calib_spec[0] != "locked" or svc.client is None:
        raise HTTPException(409, "Mover vetting needs locked calibration and catalogue clients")
    a, d = m["grid"]["crval"]
    grid = make_grid(a, d, float(m["params"]["fov"]), 6.15)
    ref = SkyCoord(a * u.deg, d * u.deg)
    radius = float(m["params"]["fov"]) / 60 / np.sqrt(2)
    stars = await GaiaClient(svc.client).cone(a, d, radius + 0.1, g_max=20)
    import asyncio

    from spherex.external.catwise import CATWISE_EPOCH_MJD, CatwiseClient
    from spherex.external.simbad import SimbadClient

    catalogue_rows = await asyncio.gather(
        CatwiseClient(svc.client).cone(a, d, radius + 0.1),
        SimbadClient(svc.client).high_pm_cone(a, d, radius + 0.15, 0),
        return_exceptions=True,
    )
    catalogue_complete = not any(isinstance(rows, BaseException) for rows in catalogue_rows)
    other_targets = []
    if isinstance(catalogue_rows[0], list):
        for c in catalogue_rows[0]:
            other_targets.append(
                Target(
                    "",
                    "star",
                    "CatWISE2020 " + c.source_name,
                    c.ra,
                    c.dec,
                    float(Time(CATWISE_EPOCH_MJD, format="mjd").jyear),
                    c.pmra,
                    c.pmdec,
                )
            )
    if isinstance(catalogue_rows[1], list):
        for s in catalogue_rows[1]:
            if s.ra is not None and s.dec is not None:
                other_targets.append(
                    Target("", "star", "SIMBAD " + s.main_id, s.ra, s.dec, 2000.0, s.pmra, s.pmdec, s.plx)
                )
    epochs = []
    bin_lookup = {b["id"]: b for bs in m["bins"].values() for b in bs}
    for b in sorted(bin_lookup.values(), key=lambda b: b["mjd_mean"]):
        binid = b["id"]
        groups = {}
        stacked = {}
        for band in range(1, 7):
            if not any(x["id"] == binid for x in m["bins"].get(str(band), [])):
                continue
            raws = await _raws(svc, m, _refs(m, band, binid))
            frames = [calibrate(r, cal, preset="discovery") for r in raws]
            frames = [f for f in frames if f.qa["ok"]]
            if len({f.photometric_scale for f in frames}) > 1:
                raise HTTPException(409, "F4 unresolved: mover detection stack mixes release scales")
            if frames:
                groups[band] = frames
                stacked[band] = build_stack([frame_to_grid(f, grid) for f in frames], _tbin(m, band, binid), grid)
        if not stacked:
            continue
        peaks: list[Any] = []
        for st in stacked.values():
            sig, _ = significance(st.mean, st.var, sky_pixels(st))
            peaks.extend(detect(sig, pix_arcsec=grid.pix_arcsec))
        if 5 in stacked and 6 in stacked:
            mean, var = red_sum(stacked[5].mean, stacked[5].var, stacked[6].mean, stacked[6].var)
            sig, _ = significance(mean, var, sky_pixels(stacked[6]))
            peaks.extend(detect(sig, pix_arcsec=grid.pix_arcsec))
        det: list[Any] = []
        for peak in sorted(peaks, key=lambda p: -p["peak"]):
            if all(np.hypot(peak["x"] - other["x"], peak["y"] - other["y"]) > 1 for other in det):
                det.append(peak)
        psfs = epsfs(cal, groups.keys())
        epoch = []
        for i, candidate in enumerate(det):
            cra, cdec = map(float, grid.wcs.pixel_to_world_values(candidate["x"], candidate["y"]))
            measurements = []
            spectral_samples: dict[int, list[Any]] = {}
            flags = set()
            chi = []
            echo = []
            for band, frames in groups.items():
                for cf in frames:
                    x, y = map(float, cf.wcs.world_to_pixel_values(cra, cdec))
                    try:
                        iz = psfs[band].zone(x + cf.origin[0], y + cf.origin[1])
                        fit = fit_native(cf.sci, cf.var, cf.bad_phot, psfs[band], iz, x, y)
                    except ValueError:
                        continue
                    if fit is None or fit.params[2] <= 3 * fit.errors[2]:
                        continue
                    ra1, dec1 = cf.wcs.pixel_to_world_values(*fit.params[:2])
                    dx, dy = ref.spherical_offsets_to(SkyCoord(ra1 * u.deg, dec1 * u.deg))
                    from spherex.astrometry import sky_covariance

                    sky_error = np.sqrt(
                        np.diag(
                            sky_covariance(cf.wcs, float(fit.params[0]), float(fit.params[1]), fit.covariance[:2, :2])
                        )
                    )
                    measurements.append([dx.arcsec, dy.arcsec, *sky_error])
                    from spherex.photometry import to_uJy

                    px, py = int(round(x + cf.origin[0])), int(round(y + cf.origin[1]))
                    ch = int(cal.channel[py, px])
                    if 1 <= ch <= 17:
                        area = float(cal.solid_angle[band][py, px])
                        spectral_samples.setdefault((band - 1) * 17 + ch - 1, []).append(
                            [float(to_uJy(fit.params[2], area)), float(to_uJy(fit.errors[2], area))]
                        )
                    flags.update(cf.flags_near(*fit.params[:2]))
                    chi.append(fit.rchi2)
                    for star in stars:
                        if (star.phot_g_mean_mag or 99) > 12:
                            continue
                        t = Target(
                            "",
                            "star",
                            str(star.source_id),
                            star.ra,
                            star.dec,
                            2016.0,
                            star.pmra,
                            star.pmdec,
                            star.parallax,
                            star.radial_velocity,
                        )
                        na, nd = t.pos([cf.mjd])
                        sx, sy = cf.wcs.world_to_pixel_values(na[0], nd[0])
                        echo.append((float(sx - x), float(sy - y)))
            if not measurements:
                continue
            vals = np.asarray(measurements)
            wx = 1 / vals[:, 2] ** 2
            wy = 1 / vals[:, 3] ** 2
            xi = float(wx @ vals[:, 0] / wx.sum())
            eta = float(wy @ vals[:, 1] / wy.sum())
            measured = ref.spherical_offsets_by(xi * u.arcsec, eta * u.arcsec)
            cra, cdec = float(measured.ra.deg), float(measured.dec.deg)
            pa, pd = parallax_factors(b["mjd_mean"], cra, cdec)
            known = None
            plx = None
            for star in stars:
                t = Target(
                    "",
                    "star",
                    str(star.source_id),
                    star.ra,
                    star.dec,
                    2016.0,
                    star.pmra,
                    star.pmdec,
                    star.parallax,
                    star.radial_velocity,
                )
                na, nd = t.pos([b["mjd_mean"]])
                if SkyCoord(cra * u.deg, cdec * u.deg).separation(SkyCoord(na[0] * u.deg, nd[0] * u.deg)).arcsec < 6.15:
                    known = f"Gaia DR3 {star.source_id}"
                    plx = max(star.parallax or 0, 0) / 1000
                    break
            if known is None:
                for source in other_targets:
                    na, nd = source.pos([b["mjd_mean"]])
                    if measured.separation(SkyCoord(na[0] * u.deg, nd[0] * u.deg)).arcsec < 6.15:
                        known = source.name
                        plx = max(source.plx or 0, 0) / 1000
                        break
            spectrum = np.full(102, np.nan)
            spectrum_error = np.full(102, np.nan)
            for ch, values in spectral_samples.items():
                flux, err = np.asarray(values).T
                weight = 1 / err**2
                spectrum[ch] = weight @ flux / weight.sum()
                spectrum_error[ch] = np.hypot(1 / np.sqrt(weight.sum()), 0.03 * abs(spectrum[ch]))
            epoch.append(
                dict(
                    id=f"{binid}-{i}",
                    xi=xi,
                    eta=eta,
                    mjd=b["mjd_mean"],
                    s_xi=float(1 / np.sqrt(wx.sum())),
                    s_eta=float(1 / np.sqrt(wy.sum())),
                    p_a=float(pa),
                    p_d=float(pd),
                    flags=sorted(flags),
                    rchi2=float(max(chi)),
                    bright_neighbours=echo,
                    visit=binid,
                    ra=cra,
                    dec=cdec,
                    known=known,
                    catalogue_parallax=plx,
                    catalogue_complete=catalogue_complete,
                    spectrum=spectrum.tolist(),
                    spectrum_err=spectrum_error.tolist(),
                )
            )
        epochs.append(epoch)
    return epochs

"""Native-frame astrometry and conditioned GLS motion fits (impl. §4.7).

Offsets and parallax are arcseconds; time is Julian years. No image resampling.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

import numpy as np
from astropy.coordinates import get_body_barycentric
from astropy.time import Time

AU_KM = 149597870.7


def sky_covariance(wcs: Any, x: float, y: float, covariance_px: Any) -> Any:
    """Local WCS Jacobian into (RA*cosDec,Dec), including detector rotation and SIP."""
    import astropy.units as u
    from astropy.coordinates import SkyCoord

    ra, dec = wcs.pixel_to_world_values(x, y)
    origin = SkyCoord(ra * u.deg, dec * u.deg)
    jac = np.empty((2, 2))
    for col, (dx, dy) in enumerate(((1e-3, 0), (0, 1e-3))):
        a, d = wcs.pixel_to_world_values(x + dx, y + dy)
        da, dd = origin.spherical_offsets_to(SkyCoord(a * u.deg, d * u.deg))
        jac[:, col] = [da.arcsec / 1e-3, dd.arcsec / 1e-3]
    return jac @ np.asarray(covariance_px) @ jac.T


def isolated(ra: Any, dec: Any, min_sep_arcsec: float = 18.0) -> Any:
    """Nearest other catalogue member, vectorized; no quadratic SkyCoord loop."""
    import astropy.units as u
    from astropy.coordinates import SkyCoord

    if len(ra) < 2:
        return np.ones(len(ra), bool)
    coords = SkyCoord(np.asarray(ra) * u.deg, np.asarray(dec) * u.deg)
    _, sep, _ = coords.match_to_catalog_sky(coords, nthneighbor=2)
    return sep.arcsec >= min_sep_arcsec


def parallax_factors(mjd: Any, ra_deg: Any, dec_deg: Any, sc_geo_km: Any = None) -> tuple[Any, Any]:
    """ICRS observer barycentric position; spacecraft offsets must be ICRS km.

    An unverified header coordinate frame must never be passed as sc_geo_km.
    Earth-only factors are adequate for stellar parallax, not nearby SSO work.
    """
    xyz = get_body_barycentric("earth", Time(mjd, format="mjd", scale="utc")).xyz.to_value("au")
    if sc_geo_km is not None:
        sc = np.asarray(sc_geo_km, float)
        if sc.shape[0] != 3 or not np.all(np.isfinite(sc)):
            raise ValueError("observer position must be finite (3, ...) ICRS kilometres")
        xyz = xyz + sc / AU_KM
    x, y, z = xyz
    a, d = np.radians(ra_deg), np.radians(dec_deg)
    return (x * np.sin(a) - y * np.cos(a), x * np.cos(a) * np.sin(d) + y * np.sin(a) * np.sin(d) - z * np.cos(d))


def gls(design: Any, values: Any, covariance: Any) -> tuple[Any, Any, float, int]:
    """Whiten then SVD; reject deficient designs instead of returning false precision."""
    a, b, c = np.asarray(design, float), np.asarray(values, float), np.asarray(covariance, float)
    if not all(np.all(np.isfinite(v)) for v in (a, b, c)) or len(b) <= a.shape[1]:
        raise ValueError("finite data and positive residual degrees of freedom required")
    chol = np.linalg.cholesky(c)
    aw, bw = np.linalg.solve(chol, a), np.linalg.solve(chol, b)
    scale = np.linalg.norm(aw, axis=0)
    if np.any(scale == 0):
        raise ValueError("unconstrained parameter")
    u, s, vt = np.linalg.svd(aw / scale, full_matrices=False)
    if s[-1] <= s[0] * 1e-10:
        raise ValueError("rank deficient or ill-conditioned motion geometry")
    p = (vt.T @ ((u.T @ bw) / s)) / scale
    cov = ((vt.T / s**2) @ vt) / np.outer(scale, scale)
    chi2 = float(np.sum((aw @ p - bw) ** 2))
    dof = len(b) - len(p)
    return p, cov * max(1.0, chi2 / dof), chi2, dof


def motion_fit(
    t_yr: Any,
    xi: Any,
    eta: Any,
    s_xi: Any,
    s_eta: Any,
    p_a: Any,
    p_d: Any,
    t0: float,
    plx_fixed: float | None = None,
    visit_ids: Any = None,
    visit_floor: float = 0.0,
    xy_covariance: Any = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Visit-shared error enters covariance blocks, so repeated frames cannot erase it."""
    t, x, y, sx, sy, pa, pd = [np.asarray(v, float) for v in (t_yr, xi, eta, s_xi, s_eta, p_a, p_d)]
    if len({v.shape for v in (t, x, y, sx, sy, pa, pd)}) != 1 or t.ndim != 1:
        raise ValueError("motion arrays must have equal one-dimensional shape")
    if np.any(sx <= 0) or np.any(sy <= 0) or visit_floor < 0:
        raise ValueError("positive errors required")
    n = len(t)
    a = np.zeros((2 * n, 5))
    a[:n, 0], a[n:, 1], a[:n, 2], a[n:, 3], a[:n, 4], a[n:, 4] = 1, 1, t - t0, t - t0, pa, pd
    b = np.r_[x, y]
    if plx_fixed is not None:
        b = b - a[:, 4] * plx_fixed
        a = a[:, :4]
    c = np.diag(np.r_[sx * sx, sy * sy])
    if xy_covariance is not None:
        xy = np.asarray(xy_covariance, float)
        if xy.shape != (n,) or not np.all(np.isfinite(xy)) or np.any(abs(xy) >= sx * sy):
            raise ValueError("finite positive-definite per-point sky covariance required")
        c[np.arange(n), n + np.arange(n)] = xy
        c[n + np.arange(n), np.arange(n)] = xy
    if visit_ids is not None:
        ids = np.asarray(visit_ids)
        shared = (ids[:, None] == ids[None, :]) * visit_floor**2
        c[:n, :n] += shared
        c[n:, n:] += shared
    p, cov, chi, dof = gls(a, b, c)
    stationary = a[:, [0, 1] + ([4] if plx_fixed is None else [])]
    _, _, chi0, _ = gls(stationary, b, c)
    return dict(
        params=p,
        covariance=cov,
        errors=np.sqrt(np.diag(cov)),
        chi2=chi,
        dof=dof,
        delta_chi2=max(0.0, chi0 - chi),
        t0=t0,
        plx_fixed=plx_fixed,
    )


def fit_pm(
    t_yr: Any, xi: Any, eta: Any, s_xi: Any, s_eta: Any, p_a: Any, p_d: Any, t0: float, plx_fixed: float | None = None
) -> tuple[Any, Any, float]:
    r = motion_fit(t_yr, xi, eta, s_xi, s_eta, p_a, p_d, t0, plx_fixed)
    return r["params"], r["errors"], r["chi2"]


def registration(residuals_arcsec: Any, errors_arcsec: Any, min_stars: int = 5) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Robust translation from isolated Gaia stars; uncertainty includes their scatter."""
    r, e = np.asarray(residuals_arcsec, float), np.asarray(errors_arcsec, float)
    ok = np.all(np.isfinite(r) & np.isfinite(e) & (e > 0), axis=1)
    for _ in range(3):
        if ok.sum() < min_stars:
            raise ValueError("registration needs at least five isolated unsaturated Gaia stars")
        med = np.median(r[ok], axis=0)
        sig = np.maximum(1.4826 * np.median(abs(r[ok] - med), axis=0), np.median(e[ok], axis=0))
        ok &= np.all(abs(r - med) <= 4 * sig, axis=1)
    return dict(
        offset=med,
        error=1.2533 * sig / np.sqrt(ok.sum()),
        used=ok,
        before_rms=np.sqrt(np.mean(r[ok] ** 2, axis=0)),
        after_rms=np.sqrt(np.mean((r[ok] - med) ** 2, axis=0)),
    )

"""QR3 table ePSFs on zero-based parent pixels; native-pixel fits (impl. §4.7).

Table orientation is preserved. F5 must validate it against stars before release.
The finite table supports ±3.2 px, and must not be extrapolated into far wings.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any

import numpy as np
from scipy.ndimage import map_coordinates
from scipy.optimize import least_squares

from .types import Grid


class EPSF:
    def __init__(self, table: Any, oversample: int = 5) -> None:
        self.xc, self.yc = np.asarray(table["XCENTER"], float), np.asarray(table["YCENTER"], float)
        psf = np.asarray(table["EPSF"], float)
        if psf.ndim != 3 or psf.shape[1] != psf.shape[2] or not np.all(np.isfinite(psf)):
            raise ValueError("EPSF must contain finite square zone arrays")
        sums = psf.sum(axis=(1, 2), keepdims=True)
        if np.any(sums <= 0) or oversample <= 0:
            raise ValueError("invalid EPSF integral or oversampling")
        self.os = oversample
        self.psf = psf / sums * self.os**2
        self.c = (psf.shape[-1] - 1) / 2

    def zone(self, xp: float, yp: float) -> int:
        if not (np.isfinite(xp) and np.isfinite(yp) and 0 <= xp < 2040 and 0 <= yp < 2040):
            raise ValueError("ePSF zone requires parent-detector pixels in [0,2040)")
        return int(np.argmin((self.xc - xp) ** 2 + (self.yc - yp) ** 2))

    def sample(self, iz: int, dx: Any, dy: Any) -> Any:
        return map_coordinates(
            self.psf[iz],
            [self.c + self.os * np.asarray(dy), self.c + self.os * np.asarray(dx)],
            order=3,
            mode="grid-constant",
            cval=0.0,
        )

    def stamp(self, iz: int, dx: float, dy: float, half: int = 3) -> Any:
        yy, xx = np.mgrid[-half : half + 1, -half : half + 1]
        return self.sample(iz, xx - dx, yy - dy)


@dataclass
class StarFit:
    params: Any
    covariance: Any
    rchi2: float
    dof: int
    wing_fit: bool
    model: Any

    @property
    def errors(self) -> Any:
        return np.sqrt(np.diag(self.covariance))


def fit_native(
    img: Any,
    var: Any,
    bad: Any,
    epsf: EPSF,
    iz: int,
    x0: float,
    y0: float,
    half: int = 3,
    fixed_xy: bool = False,
    max_shift: float = 1.5,
    background_order: int = 0,
) -> StarFit | None:
    if background_order not in (0, 1):
        raise ValueError("background order must be constant or plane")
    ix, iy = int(round(x0)), int(round(y0))
    ny, nx = img.shape
    if ix - half < 0 or iy - half < 0 or ix + half >= nx or iy + half >= ny:
        return None
    sl = np.s_[iy - half : iy + half + 1, ix - half : ix + half + 1]
    d, v = np.asarray(img[sl], float), np.asarray(var[sl], float)
    mask = bad[sl] | ~np.isfinite(d) | ~np.isfinite(v) | (v <= 0)
    npar = (2 if fixed_xy else 4) + 2 * background_order
    if (~mask).sum() < npar + 3:
        return None

    def model(p: Any) -> Any:
        x, y, f, b = (x0, y0, *p[:2]) if fixed_xy else p[:4]
        result = f * epsf.stamp(iz, x - ix, y - iy, half) + b
        if background_order:
            yy, xx = np.mgrid[-half : half + 1, -half : half + 1]
            result = result + p[-2] * xx + p[-1] * yy
        return result

    def resid(p: Any) -> Any:
        return (d - model(p))[~mask] / np.sqrt(v[~mask])

    f0 = float(np.sum(d[~mask] - np.median(d[~mask])))
    p0 = [f0, float(np.median(d[~mask]))] if fixed_xy else [x0, y0, f0, float(np.median(d[~mask]))]
    if background_order:
        p0 += [0.0, 0.0]
    bounds = (
        (-np.inf, np.inf)
        if fixed_xy
        else ([x0 - max_shift, y0 - max_shift, -np.inf, -np.inf], [x0 + max_shift, y0 + max_shift, np.inf, np.inf])
    )
    if background_order and not fixed_xy:
        bounds = (list(bounds[0]) + [-np.inf, -np.inf], list(bounds[1]) + [np.inf, np.inf])
    r = least_squares(resid, p0, bounds=bounds, xtol=1e-11, ftol=1e-11, gtol=1e-11)
    if not r.success or (not fixed_xy and np.any(r.active_mask[:2])):
        return None
    _, s, vt = np.linalg.svd(r.jac, full_matrices=False)
    if s[-1] <= s[0] * 1e-10:
        return None
    dof = r.fun.size - npar
    chi = float(r.fun @ r.fun / dof)
    cov = ((vt.T / s**2) @ vt) * max(1.0, chi)
    return StarFit(r.x, cov, chi, dof, bool(mask[half - 1 : half + 2, half - 1 : half + 2].any()), model(r.x))


def fit_star(
    img: Any,
    var: Any,
    bad: Any,
    epsf: EPSF,
    iz: int,
    x0: float,
    y0: float,
    half: int = 3,
    fixed_xy: bool = False,
    max_shift: float = 1.5,
) -> Any:
    r = fit_native(img, var, bad, epsf, iz, x0, y0, half, fixed_xy, max_shift)
    return None if r is None else (r.params, r.errors, r.rchi2)


def fit_sources(img: Any, var: Any, bad: Any, epsf: EPSF, positions: Any, zones: Any, half: int = 4) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Simultaneous fixed-position signed amplitudes + sky, retaining blend covariance.

    Negative flux is valid for a non-detection. A nearly unresolved pair is rejected.
    """
    pos = np.asarray(positions, float)
    x0, y0 = np.mean(pos, axis=0)
    ix, iy = int(round(x0)), int(round(y0))
    if ix - half < 0 or iy - half < 0 or ix + half >= img.shape[1] or iy + half >= img.shape[0]:
        raise ValueError("blend stamp off image")
    yy, xx = np.mgrid[iy - half : iy + half + 1, ix - half : ix + half + 1]
    sl = np.s_[iy - half : iy + half + 1, ix - half : ix + half + 1]
    d, v = img[sl], var[sl]
    ok = ~bad[sl] & np.isfinite(d) & np.isfinite(v) & (v > 0)
    a = np.stack(
        [epsf.sample(z, xx - x, yy - y) for (x, y), z in zip(pos, zones, strict=True)] + [np.ones(d.shape)], axis=-1
    )
    from .astrometry import gls

    p, c, chi, dof = gls(a[ok], d[ok], np.diag(v[ok]))
    return dict(flux=p[:-1], covariance=c[:-1, :-1], background=p[-1], rchi2=chi / dof, dof=dof)


def fit_blend(
    img: Any,
    var: Any,
    bad: Any,
    epsf: EPSF,
    positions: Any,
    zones: Any,
    max_shift: float = 1.5,
    half: int = 4,
    shared_shift: bool = False,
) -> StarFit | None:
    """Joint signed flux covariance with a free centroid or shared WCS translation.

    shared_shift preserves catalogue separations and lets a bright neighbour constrain
    the local WCS translation even when the forced target flux is consistent with zero.
    The translation is a fitted nuisance parameter, never an exact registration.
    """
    pos = np.asarray(positions, float)
    ix, iy = np.rint(pos.mean(axis=0)).astype(int)
    if ix - half < 0 or iy - half < 0 or ix + half >= img.shape[1] or iy + half >= img.shape[0]:
        return None
    sl = np.s_[iy - half : iy + half + 1, ix - half : ix + half + 1]
    yy, xx = np.mgrid[iy - half : iy + half + 1, ix - half : ix + half + 1]
    d, v = img[sl], var[sl]
    ok = ~bad[sl] & np.isfinite(d) & np.isfinite(v) & (v > 0)
    npar = 3 + len(pos)
    if ok.sum() < npar + 3:
        return None
    try:
        seed = fit_sources(img, var, bad, epsf, pos, zones, half)
    except (ValueError, np.linalg.LinAlgError):
        return None

    def model(p: Any) -> Any:
        xy = pos + (p[:2] - pos[0]) if shared_shift else np.vstack([p[:2], pos[1:]])
        return sum(f * epsf.sample(z, xx - x, yy - y) for (x, y), f, z in zip(xy, p[2:-1], zones, strict=True)) + p[-1]

    p0 = np.r_[pos[0], seed["flux"], seed["background"]]
    lb = np.r_[pos[0] - max_shift, np.full(len(pos) + 1, -np.inf)]
    ub = np.r_[pos[0] + max_shift, np.full(len(pos) + 1, np.inf)]
    r = least_squares(lambda p: (d - model(p))[ok] / np.sqrt(v[ok]), p0, bounds=(lb, ub))
    _, s, vt = np.linalg.svd(r.jac, full_matrices=False)
    if not r.success or np.any(r.active_mask[:2]) or s[-1] <= s[0] * 1e-10:
        return None
    dof = len(r.fun) - npar
    chi = float(r.fun @ r.fun / dof)
    return StarFit(
        r.x,
        ((vt.T / s**2) @ vt) * max(1.0, chi),
        chi,
        dof,
        bool((~ok)[half - 1 : half + 2, half - 1 : half + 2].any()),
        model(r.x),
    )


@dataclass
class FittedPSF:
    """M→I display model preserving the native PSF orientation through its WCS."""

    epsf: EPSF
    zone_id: int
    wcs: Any
    x: float
    y: float
    flux: float

    def render(self, grid: Grid) -> Any:
        yy, xx = np.indices(grid.shape)
        nx, ny = self.wcs.world_to_pixel(grid.wcs.pixel_to_world(xx, yy))
        return self.flux * self.epsf.sample(self.zone_id, nx - self.x, ny - self.y)

"""Native forced photometry, blend covariance, spectra and indices (impl. §4.8)."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

import numpy as np

from .epsf import EPSF, fit_blend, fit_native
from .types import CalFrame

SR_PER_ARCSEC2 = (np.pi / 648000.0) ** 2


def scale_template(wavelength: Any, flux: Any, errors: Any, template_wave: Any, template_flux: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Least-squares signed scale on common coverage; never extrapolate a library template."""
    wave, f, e, tl, tf = map(lambda v: np.asarray(v, float), (wavelength, flux, errors, template_wave, template_flux))
    if np.any(np.diff(tl) <= 0):
        raise ValueError("template wavelengths must increase")
    ok = np.isfinite(wave) & np.isfinite(f) & np.isfinite(e) & (e > 0) & (wave >= tl[0]) & (wave <= tl[-1])
    if ok.sum() < 3:
        raise ValueError("at least three common template samples required")
    model = np.interp(wave[ok], tl, tf)
    w = 1 / e[ok] ** 2
    normal = float(w @ (model * model))
    if normal <= 0:
        raise ValueError("template has no support")
    scale = float(w @ (f[ok] * model) / normal)
    chi = float(np.sum(w * (f[ok] - scale * model) ** 2))
    dof = int(ok.sum() - 1)
    return dict(scale=scale, error=float(np.sqrt(max(1.0, chi / dof) / normal)), chi2=chi, dof=dof, used=ok)


def to_uJy(f_pix_sum_mjysr: Any, omega_arcsec2: Any) -> Any:
    return f_pix_sum_mjysr * np.asarray(omega_arcsec2) * SR_PER_ARCSEC2 * 1e12


def ab_mag(uJy: Any) -> Any:
    f = np.asarray(uJy, float)
    with np.errstate(divide="ignore", invalid="ignore"):
        return np.where(f > 0, 23.9 - 2.5 * np.log10(f), np.nan)


def wise_colour(points: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> float:
    """Approximate Vega W1-W2 using official photon RSRs; W2 >5um is absent.

    RSR integrated in dln(lambda), as appropriate for photon counting and Fnu.
    AB-to-Vega offsets 2.699/3.339: WISE All-Sky Supplement IV.4.h Table 3.
    """
    from pathlib import Path

    require_common_scale(points)
    rows = [p for p in points if not p.get("contaminated", False)]
    wave = np.array([p["lam"] for p in rows])
    f = np.array([p["flux_uJy"] for p in rows])
    errors = np.array([p.get("stat_err_uJy", p["err_uJy"]) for p in rows])
    order = np.argsort(wave)
    wave, f, errors = wave[order], f[order], errors[order]
    unique, inverse = np.unique(wave, return_inverse=True)
    weights = 1 / errors**2
    f = np.bincount(inverse, weights=weights * f) / np.bincount(inverse, weights=weights)
    wave = unique
    if len(wave) < 20 or wave[0] > 2.8 or wave[-1] < 4.95:
        raise ValueError("insufficient W1/W2 spectral coverage")
    flux = []
    for band in ["W1", "W2"]:
        table = np.loadtxt(Path(__file__).parent / "data" / f"wise_{band}.txt")
        flux.append(synthetic_wise(wave, f, table[:, 0], table[:, 1]))
    if min(flux) <= 0:
        raise ValueError("positive integrated flux required for colour")
    return float(-2.5 * np.log10(flux[0] / flux[1]) + 0.640)


def spectrum_point(
    frame: CalFrame, epsf: Any, ra: float, dec: float, omega_arcsec2: float, neighbours: Any = ()
) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    """A signed flux and total error; forced positions and wavelength are native.

    Neighbours are sky coordinates, jointly fitted, never subtracted without uncertainty.
    The 3% floor is carried separately and must not average down as independent noise.
    """
    if not frame.qa["ok"]:
        return None
    x, y = map(float, frame.wcs.world_to_pixel_values(ra, dec))
    ix, iy = int(round(x)), int(round(y))
    if not (0 <= ix < frame.sci.shape[1] and 0 <= iy < frame.sci.shape[0]):
        return None
    lam, dlam = frame.lam[iy, ix], frame.dlam[iy, ix]
    if not (np.isfinite(lam) and np.isfinite(dlam) and lam > 0 and dlam > 0 and omega_arcsec2 > 0):
        return None
    psf: EPSF = epsf[frame.detector] if isinstance(epsf, dict) else epsf
    zone = psf.zone(frame.origin[0] + x, frame.origin[1] + y)
    if len(neighbours):
        positions = [(x, y)] + [tuple(map(float, frame.wcs.world_to_pixel_values(*p))) for p in neighbours]
        zones = [psf.zone(frame.origin[0] + a, frame.origin[1] + b) for a, b in positions]
        r = fit_blend(frame.sci, frame.var, frame.bad_phot, psf, positions, zones, shared_shift=True)
        if r is None:
            return None
        f, ef, chi = r.params[2], r.errors[2], r.rchi2
        wing = bool(frame.bad_phot[max(0, iy - 1) : iy + 2, max(0, ix - 1) : ix + 2].any())
    else:
        fit = fit_native(frame.sci, frame.var, frame.bad_phot, psf, zone, x, y, fixed_xy=True)
        if fit is None:
            return None
        f, ef, chi, wing = fit.params[0], fit.errors[0], fit.rchi2, fit.wing_fit
    F, eF = map(float, (to_uJy(f, omega_arcsec2), to_uJy(ef, omega_arcsec2)))
    flags = frame.flags_near(x, y)
    contamination = set(flags) - {"SOURCE", "FULLSAMPLE", "OUTLIER", "STREAK"}
    return dict(
        lam=float(lam),
        dlam=float(dlam),
        flux_uJy=F,
        err_uJy=float(np.hypot(eF, 0.03 * abs(F))),
        stat_err_uJy=eF,
        cal_err_uJy=0.03 * abs(F),
        mjd=frame.mjd,
        detector=frame.detector,
        obsid=frame.obsid,
        rchi2=float(chi),
        flags_near=flags,
        wing_fit=wing,
        contaminated=bool(contamination) or abs(lam - 1.083) <= max(dlam / 2, 0.01),
        photometric_scale=frame.photometric_scale,
        blend_fit=bool(len(neighbours)),
        blend_registration="joint shared translation" if len(neighbours) else None,
        omega_arcsec2=omega_arcsec2,
        zone=zone,
    )


def require_common_scale(points: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> None:
    if len({p["photometric_scale"] for p in points}) > 1:
        raise ValueError("F4 unresolved: cross-release photometric aggregation prohibited")


def methane_index(points: list[dict[str, Any]], field_ratios: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    require_common_scale(points)

    def band(lo: float, hi: float) -> tuple[float, float]:
        rows = [p for p in points if lo <= p["lam"] <= hi and not p.get("contaminated", False)]
        if not rows:
            raise ValueError("index wavelength coverage missing")
        f = np.array([p["flux_uJy"] for p in rows])
        e = np.array([p.get("stat_err_uJy", p["err_uJy"]) for p in rows])
        w = 1 / e**2
        return float(w @ f / w.sum()), float(np.hypot(1 / np.sqrt(w.sum()), 0.03 * abs(w @ f / w.sum())))

    a, ea = band(3.25, 3.40)
    b, eb = band(3.95, 4.20)
    field = np.asarray(field_ratios, float)
    field = field[np.isfinite(field) & (field > 0)]
    if not field.size or b <= 3 * eb:
        raise ValueError("field calibration and a significant denominator required")
    med = float(np.median(field))
    emed = 1.2533 * 1.4826 * float(np.median(abs(field - med))) / np.sqrt(len(field))
    ratio = a / b / med
    err = np.sqrt((ea / b / med) ** 2 + (a * eb / b**2 / med) ** 2 + (a * emed / b / med**2) ** 2)
    return dict(methane_rel=ratio, error=float(err), field_median=med, n_field=len(field))


def synthetic_wise(lam: Any, flux: Any, response_lam: Any, response: Any) -> float:
    """Response-weighted Fnu, no extrapolation over missing wavelength coverage.

    Caller provides a documented photon response converted to dln(lambda) weights.
    SPHEREx W2 truncation must be labelled approximate.
    """
    wavelength, f, r, w = map(lambda x: np.asarray(x, float), (lam, flux, response_lam, response))
    order = np.argsort(wavelength)
    wavelength, f = wavelength[order], f[order]
    if len(wavelength) < 2 or np.any(np.diff(wavelength) <= 0) or np.any(w < 0) or not np.all(np.isfinite(f)):
        raise ValueError("finite increasing spectral sampling and nonnegative response required")
    keep = (r >= wavelength[0]) & (r <= wavelength[-1]) & (w > 0)
    if keep.sum() < 2:
        raise ValueError("no response coverage")
    return float(
        np.trapezoid(np.interp(r[keep], wavelength, f) * w[keep], np.log(r[keep]))
        / np.trapezoid(w[keep], np.log(r[keep]))
    )

"""Run M target acceptance through the production API integration on pinned real frames.

Examples: python scripts/verify/m_acceptance.py --target epsindb --product spectrum
          python scripts/verify/m_acceptance.py --target barnard --product astrometry
Outputs include native rows, failed frames, independent catalogue parameters, hashes,
and a plot. This script never substitutes simulated measurements for archive data.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import asyncio
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
sys.path[:0] = [str(ROOT / "backend"), str(ROOT / "scripts")]
import numpy as np
from _m_evidence import record
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw

from app.measurement import astrometry_api, lightcurve_api, spectrum_api
from app.pipeline import plan_view, skeleton
from app.services import Services
from app.settings import Settings


async def main(args):
    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8")
    pin = next(
        json.loads(p.read_text())
        for p in (ROOT / "config/pins").glob("*.json")
        if p.stem != "index"
        and json.loads(p.read_text())["params"]["target"] == args.target
    )
    names = {
        "barnard": "Barnard's Star",
        "epsindb": "eps Ind B",
        "wise0855": "WISE 0855",
        "rwaur": "RW Aur",
        "rdra": "R Dra",
    }
    svc = Services(
        Settings(
            cache_dir=ROOT / ".cache/m-acceptance",
            calib_root=ROOT / ".cache/calib",
            environment="local",
            cpu_workers=0,
            run_watcher=False,
        )
    )
    try:
        plan = await plan_view(
            svc, {"q": names[args.target], "pin": pin["pin"], "fov": "12", "px": "6.15"}
        )
        m = skeleton(svc, plan)
        svc.store.put_manifest(plan.key, m)
        a, d = plan.target.pos([float(np.median([r.t_min for r in plan.refs]))])
        ra, dec = float(a[0]), float(d[0])
        if args.product == "spectrum":
            out = await spectrum_api(svc, ra, dec, key=plan.key)
        elif args.product == "astrometry":
            out = await astrometry_api(svc, ra, dec, names[args.target], key=plan.key)
        else:
            out = await lightcurve_api(
                svc,
                ra,
                dec,
                method="annulus" if args.target == "rdra" else "psf",
                release=args.release,
                key=plan.key,
            )
        dest = ROOT / ".cache/m-acceptance" / f"{args.target}-{args.product}.json"
        dest.write_text(
            json.dumps(
                out,
                indent=2,
                default=lambda o: o.item() if hasattr(o, "item") else str(o),
            )
        )
        # Show actual points, preserving signed non-detections. No template figure.
        pairs = (
            [(r["lam"], r["flux"]) for r in out.get("rows", [])]
            if args.product == "spectrum"
            else [(r["xi"], r["eta"]) for r in out.get("points", [])]
        )
        img = Image.new("RGB", (800, 480), "white")
        draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
        draw.text(
            (20, 12),
            f"{args.target} {args.product}: native real measurements; unaccepted",
            fill="black",
        )
        if pairs:
            x, y = np.asarray(pairs).T
            dx = max(float(np.ptp(x)), 1e-9)
            dy = max(float(np.ptp(y)), 1e-9)
            for a, b in zip(x, y, strict=True):
                px = 40 + 700 * (a - x.min()) / dx
                py = 440 - 380 * (b - y.min()) / dy
                draw.ellipse((px - 2, py - 2, px + 2, py + 2), fill="navy")
        import io

        buf = io.BytesIO()
        img.save(buf, format="PNG")
        metrics = {}
        verdict = "inconclusive"
        if args.target == "epsindb" and args.product == "spectrum":
            detected = {
                d: any(
                    r["flux"] > 5 * r["err"]
                    for r in out["rows"]
                    if r["detector"] == d and not r["contaminated"]
                )
                for d in range(1, 7)
            }
            methane = [
                v["methane_rel"]
                for v in out["indices_by_visit"].values()
                if "methane_rel" in v
            ]
            ok = (
                all(detected.values())
                and bool(methane)
                and all(v < 0.5 for v in methane)
            )
            metrics = {
                "detected": dict(
                    value=detected,
                    threshold="all six detectors",
                    **{"pass": all(detected.values())},
                ),
                "methane_relative": dict(
                    value=methane,
                    threshold="<0.5",
                    **{"pass": bool(methane) and all(v < 0.5 for v in methane)},
                ),
            }
            verdict = "pass" if ok else "fail"
        if args.target == "wise0855" and args.product == "spectrum":
            metrics = {}
            ok = True
            full = [b["id"] for b in m["bins"]["6"] if b["status"] == "full"]
            for visit in full:
                for band in [1, 2, 3, 6]:
                    rows = [
                        r
                        for r in out["rows"]
                        if r["visit"] == visit
                        and r["detector"] == band
                        and not r["contaminated"]
                    ]
                    if not rows:
                        metrics[f"{visit}_D{band}"] = dict(
                            value=None,
                            threshold="native blend S/N; missing clean fits",
                            **{"pass": False},
                        )
                        ok = False
                        continue
                    f = np.array([r["flux"] for r in rows])
                    e = np.array([r["quality"]["stat_err_uJy"] for r in rows])
                    w = 1 / e**2
                    mean = float(w @ f / w.sum())
                    err = float(np.hypot(1 / np.sqrt(w.sum()), 0.03 * abs(mean)))
                    snr = mean / err
                    passed = snr >= 5 if band == 6 else abs(snr) < 3
                    metrics[f"{visit}_D{band}"] = dict(
                        value=snr,
                        threshold=">=5"
                        if band == 6
                        else "abs(S/N)<3 (signed blend flux must be consistent with zero)",
                        **{"pass": passed},
                    )
                    ok &= passed
            verdict = "pass" if ok and len(full) == 2 else "fail"
        if args.product == "astrometry" and out.get("fit"):
            f = out["fit"]
            cat = out.get("catalogue")
            tolerance = 1.0 if args.target == "barnard" else 1.5
            pa_tol = 6.0 if args.target == "barnard" else 20.0
            if cat:
                dm = abs(f["mu"] - cat["mu"])
                dp = abs((f["pa_deg"] - cat["pa_deg"] + 180) % 360 - 180)
                metrics = {
                    "pm_error_arcsec_yr": dict(
                        value=dm, threshold=f"<{tolerance}", **{"pass": dm < tolerance}
                    ),
                    "pa_error_deg": dict(
                        value=dp, threshold=f"<{pa_tol}", **{"pass": dp < pa_tol}
                    ),
                }
                verdict = "pass" if dm < tolerance and dp < pa_tol else "fail"
            if args.target == "wise0855":
                # A 10.2 specifies full-visit displacement, not a newly invented
                # proper-motion tolerance. Use the same native two-source points.
                visits = {}
                for point in out.get("points", []):
                    if point.get("fit_included", False):
                        visits.setdefault(point["visit"], []).append(point)
                centres = []
                for points in visits.values():
                    centres.append(
                        (
                            np.mean([p["mjd"] for p in points]),
                            np.mean([p["xi"] for p in points]),
                            np.mean([p["eta"] for p in points]),
                        )
                    )
                centres.sort()
                if len(centres) == 2:
                    delta = np.asarray(centres[1][1:]) - np.asarray(centres[0][1:])
                    displacement = float(np.hypot(*delta) / 6.15)
                    pa = float(np.degrees(np.arctan2(*delta)) % 360)
                    pa_error = abs((pa - 277 + 180) % 360 - 180)
                    ok = abs(displacement - 0.78) <= 0.3 and pa_error <= 20
                    metrics = {
                        "displacement_px": dict(
                            value=displacement,
                            threshold="0.78 +/-0.3",
                            **{"pass": abs(displacement - 0.78) <= 0.3},
                        ),
                        "pa_deg": dict(
                            value=pa, threshold="277 +/-20", **{"pass": pa_error <= 20}
                        ),
                    }
                    verdict = "pass" if ok else "fail"
                else:
                    metrics = {
                        "full_visits": dict(
                            value=len(centres),
                            threshold="exactly two full band-6 visits",
                            **{"pass": False},
                        )
                    }
                    verdict = "fail"
        if args.target == "rdra" and args.product == "lightcurve":
            bins = {p["bin"] for rows in out["bands"].values() for p in rows}
            period = out.get("periodogram")
            best = period["best_days"] if period else None
            metrics = {
                "independent_bins": dict(
                    value=len(bins), threshold=">=20", **{"pass": len(bins) >= 20}
                ),
                "period_days": dict(
                    value=best,
                    threshold="245 +/-30 days",
                    **{"pass": best is not None and abs(best - 245) <= 30},
                ),
            }
            verdict = (
                "pass"
                if len(bins) >= 20 and best is not None and abs(best - 245) <= 30
                else "fail"
            )
        if args.target == "rwaur" and args.product == "lightcurve":
            counts = {d: len(points) for d, points in out["bands"].items()}
            # Bins are not visits. This reports coverage without promoting a
            # same-release subset to the required three-visit result.
            metrics = {
                "points_by_band": dict(
                    value=counts,
                    threshold="at least three visits per band, not just time bins",
                    **{"pass": None},
                )
            }
            verdict = "inconclusive"
        check = {
            "spectrum": {"epsindb": "G4b-epsind", "wise0855": "G4b-wise-stacks"},
            "astrometry": {},
            "lightcurve": {"rdra": "G5.lc-rdra", "rwaur": "G5.lc-rwaur"},
        }[args.product].get(
            args.target,
            f"G3-pm-{args.target}"
            if args.product == "astrometry"
            else "M-rwaur-spectrum",
        )
        record(
            check,
            "L3",
            verdict,
            metrics,
            "# Native target acceptance\nComplete measurements and rejected frames:\n```json\n"
            + dest.read_text()
            + "\n```\n"
            "A passing numerical sample is still subject to foundations, external comparison and I review.",
            [
                r.access_url
                for r in plan.refs
                if r.id in set(out.get("native_frames", [f.id for f in plan.refs]))
            ],
            n_frames=len(out.get("native_frames", plan.refs)),
            pins=[pin["pin"]],
            author="M",
            code_paths=[
                "backend/app/measurement.py",
                "backend/spherex/photometry.py",
                "backend/spherex/astrometry.py",
                "backend/spherex/epsf.py",
                "scripts/verify/m_acceptance.py",
            ],
            figures={"measurements.png": buf.getvalue()},
        )
    except Exception as ex:
        check = (
            "G5.lc-rdra"
            if args.target == "rdra"
            else f"M-{args.target}-{args.product}-failure"
        )
        record(
            check,
            "L3" if "plan" in locals() else "L0",
            "fail",
            {},
            "# Native acceptance failed\n"
            + f"{type(ex).__name__}: {ex}\nNo replacement data or relaxed criterion used.",
            [r.access_url for r in plan.refs] if "plan" in locals() else [],
            pins=[pin["pin"]],
            author="M",
            code_paths=[
                "backend/app/measurement.py",
                "backend/spherex/lightcurve.py",
                "scripts/verify/m_acceptance.py",
            ],
        )
        raise
    finally:
        await svc.close()
